import { readFile } from "fs";
import * as path from "path";

export const CONFIG_PATH = "./config/app.toml";

export function loadConfig(name) {
  const full = "SELECT * FROM configs WHERE name = " + name + " LIMIT 1";
  return full;
}

export default class Service {
  async start() {
    const data = await readFile(path.join(".", "data.json"));
    return data;
  }
}
